shell.purpose: Owns application state, orchestration, persistence, input handling and rendering coordination.

building.purpose: Owns building geometry and building-specific coordination records.

decking.purpose: Owns deck framing, boards, edges, posts, supports and member reviews.

services.purpose: Owns measured routes, fittings, fixtures, connections, envelopes and physical review overlays.

boundaryRules: Domains communicate through model records and the registered facade; there are no network calls between domains.
The shell is the only owner of persistence, history, selection, input routing and cross-domain rendering order.
A domain may add files without creating a new deployable or a second source of truth.
Extract a separate service only after independent deployment, scaling, ownership or isolation is demonstrated.
